# Imbalance exposure, stage 1 (backtest pilot): results (generated by imbalance_cost/score.py)

A pilot on days the foundation models may have seen in training; no money claim (PLAN.md §5). Labels come from unadjusted 90% intervals and are not tests. Positive exposure is a loss.

## Headline (PLAN.md §11)

In a backtest the foundation models may have seen in training, a price-taking supplier using Chronos-2's day-ahead demand forecast would have had net imbalance exposure not clearly different from one using a weather regression (75 against 86 £ per GWh of demand).

Days scored: 953; dropped for a missing price or forecast: 2024-04-13, 2025-06-27, 2025-06-28, 2025-06-29, 2026-07-27, 2026-09-11, 2026-09-12.
